summary: Iteration 15 backend verification: NEW endpoint DELETE /api/invoices/{invoice_id} works exactly per spec. Added 11 new tests under TestDeleteInvoice covering: 200 success with Arabic message 'تم حذف الفاتورة بنجاح'; 404 with 'الفاتورة غير موجودة' for non-existent but well-formed ObjectId; 400 with 'معرّف غير صالح' for malformed id (via global InvalidId handler); 401 without JWT and 401 with invalid JWT; cascade deletion of related payments (no orphans in db.payments); customer.current_balance recalculation to 0 when the ONLY unpaid invoice is deleted; customer.current_balance falls back to remaining_amount of most-recent unpaid invoice when others still exist; deletion isolation (other customers' invoices/payments/balances unaffected); regression on customer cascade delete; regression on suspend toggle. Result: 94/94 PASSED (100%). Full suite runs in ~22s. No regressions.

minor.issue: Balance recalculation uses the most-recent unpaid invoice's remaining_amount as the customer's current_balance. This matches the write-path in POST /api/invoices and POST /api/invoices/{id}/payment (both overwrite current_balance with a single invoice's remaining). Consider migrating to sum(remaining_amount) across all unpaid/partial invoices for a customer to represent true total debt — currently the field represents 'latest invoice remaining', which can under-report actual outstanding when multiple unpaid invoices exist.
Not wrapped in a MongoDB transaction; if the payments delete succeeds but the invoice delete fails, orphan state is possible. Low risk on single-replica setups.
(carried) safe_object_id() helper still defined but never called - dead code.
(carried) status query param not whitelisted; O(N) update_one for is_overdue - prefer update_many.
(carried) No amount>0 validation; expense_type still free-form (no Enum).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider changing customer.current_balance semantics from 'latest unpaid invoice remaining' to 'sum of all unpaid/partial remaining_amount' so deleting/adding invoices doesn't hide older debts. Current DELETE endpoint matches the existing write-path convention, so it's consistent but the underlying convention may itself be off.
OPTIONAL: Wrap DELETE /api/invoices/{id} cascade (payments delete + invoice delete + customer balance update) in a single MongoDB transaction.
OPTIONAL (carried): Remove unused safe_object_id() helper in server.py L40-44.
OPTIONAL (carried): Whitelist status values on GET /api/invoices; make expense_type an Enum; validate amount>0 on payments/expenses; batch is_overdue update via update_many.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L585-611 DELETE /api/invoices/{invoice_id}: correctly (a) fetches invoice, returns 404 with Arabic detail if missing; (b) deletes payments by invoice_id; (c) deletes the invoice; (d) recalculates customer.current_balance from most-recent unpaid/partial invoice (0.0 if none). JWT required via api_router dependency. Invalid ObjectId falls through to global @app.exception_handler(InvalidId) -> 400.

Semantics note: current_balance is the LATEST unpaid invoice's remaining, not the total debt across all unpaid invoices. This is consistent with the create_invoice and add_payment write-paths, but may misrepresent total outstanding when multiple unpaid invoices exist. Not a bug per spec, but flagged for product review.
Route ordering: DELETE handler is defined AFTER GET /api/invoices/{invoice_id} and POST /api/invoices/{invoice_id}/payment, no shadowing risk since methods differ.
Cascade is non-transactional (motor + single delete_many + delete_one + update_one) — low risk but not atomic.
